meta.name: Divine and Demonic Qualities
meta.outline: Verses 1–3: twenty-six divine qualities; 4–5: the demonic qualities, and where each kind leads; 6–18: how demonic people think and act; 19–20: what becomes of them; 21–22: desire, anger and greed, the three gates to hell; 23–24: the scriptures as a guide to what should be done.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Krishna said: Fearlessness, purity of heart, steadiness in knowledge and yoga, giving, self-control, sacrifice, study of the scriptures, self-discipline and honesty;

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: non-violence, truthfulness, freedom from anger, letting go, peace, not speaking ill of others, kindness to all beings, freedom from greed, gentleness, modesty and steadiness;

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: these belong to one born with the divine qualities
verses.tr: vigour, forgiveness, courage, purity, freedom from ill will and from pride: these, Arjuna, belong to a person born with the divine qualities.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: belong to one born with the demonic qualities
verses.tr: Pretence, arrogance, conceit, anger, harshness and ignorance: these, Arjuna, belong to a person born with the demonic qualities.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: the divine qualities lead to freedom
the demonic are held to lead to bondage
you are born with the divine qualities
verses.tr: The divine qualities lead to freedom, and the demonic to bondage. Do not grieve, Arjuna: you are born with the divine qualities.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: द्वौ भूतसर्गौ लोकेऽस्मिन् दैव आसुर एव च
दैवो विस्तरशः प्रोक्त आसुरं पार्थ मे शृणु
words: there are two kinds of beings in this world
the divine has been described at length
now hear from me about the demonic
verses.tr: There are two kinds of beings in this world, the divine and the demonic. I have described the divine at length. Now hear from me, Arjuna, about the demonic.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुरासुराः
न शौचं नापि चाचारो न सत्यं तेषु विद्यते
words: what to do and what not to do
न शौचं न अपि च आचारः
nor truth is found in them
verses.tr: Demonic people do not know what should be done and what should not be done. Neither purity, nor good conduct, nor truth is found in them.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: they say the world has no truth and no foundation
that it is born of the union of male and female
that desire is its only cause
verses.tr: They say that the world has no truth, no foundation and no Lord, that it is born only of the union of male and female, and that desire is its only cause.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: as enemies of the world, to destroy it
verses.tr: Holding to this view, these lost souls of little understanding do cruel deeds and rise up as enemies of the world, to destroy it.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: giving themselves to desire that can never be filled
full of pretence, pride and arrogance
holding false ideas out of delusion
verses.tr: Giving themselves to desire that can never be filled, full of pretence, pride and arrogance, they hold on to false ideas out of delusion and act with impure aims.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: they take the enjoyment of desires as the highest aim
sure that this is all there is
verses.tr: Burdened with endless worries that end only at death, they take the enjoyment of desires as the highest aim and are sure that this is all there is.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: bound by hundreds of ropes of hope
given over to desire and anger
for the sake of enjoying their desires
to pile up wealth by unjust means
verses.tr: Bound by hundreds of ropes of hope, given over to desire and anger, they strive to pile up wealth by unjust means so as to enjoy their desires.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: this wish I shall fulfil next
इदम् अपि मे भविष्यति पुनः धनम्
and this wealth too will be mine
verses.tr: “Today I have gained this, and next I shall get what I want. This is mine, and that wealth too will be mine.”

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: and I shall kill the others too
I am successful, strong and happy
verses.tr: “I have killed that enemy, and I shall kill the others too. I am the lord. I am the enjoyer. I am successful, strong and happy.”

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: I am rich and well born
who else is equal to me
I shall sacrifice, I shall give, I shall rejoice
so they think, deluded by ignorance
verses.tr: “I am rich and well born. Who is equal to me? I shall offer sacrifices, I shall give gifts, I shall rejoice.” So they think, deluded by ignorance.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: caught in the net of delusion
addicted to the enjoyment of desires
they fall into a foul hell
verses.tr: Confused by many thoughts, caught in the net of delusion and addicted to the enjoyment of their desires, they fall into a foul hell.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: they perform sacrifices in name only
and not in the right way
verses.tr: Full of themselves, stubborn, and drunk with wealth and pride, they perform sacrifices in name only, for show and not in the right way.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः
words: अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः
given over to ego, force, arrogance, desire and anger
hating me in their own bodies and in the bodies of others
verses.tr: Given over to ego, force, arrogance, desire and anger, these envious people hate me, who live in their own bodies and in the bodies of others.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: the lowest of people, in the cycle of rebirth
verses.tr: These hateful, cruel and harmful people, the lowest of humankind, I throw again and again into demonic births in the cycle of rebirth.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: they sink to the lowest state
verses.tr: Falling into demonic births and deluded in life after life, Arjuna, they never reach me, and they sink to the lowest state.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: this gate of hell is of three kinds
so one should give up these three
verses.tr: There are three gates to hell, which destroy the soul: desire, anger and greed. So give up these three.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: a person, from the three gates of darkness
does what is good for the soul
and so reaches the highest goal
verses.tr: A person who is freed from these three gates of darkness, Arjuna, does what is good for the soul and so reaches the highest goal.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: न स सिद्धिमवाप्नोति न सुखं न परां गतिम्
words: whoever sets aside the guidance of the scriptures
and acts as desire drives him
nor happiness, nor the highest goal
verses.tr: Whoever sets aside the guidance of the scriptures and acts as desire drives them reaches neither perfection, nor happiness, nor the highest goal.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: so let the scriptures be your guide
in deciding what to do and what not to do
you should do your work in this world
verses.tr: So let the scriptures be your guide in deciding what to do and what not to do. Knowing what the scriptures teach, do your work in this world.
